description: Verify that echoUINT8E2E — DUT echoes the 4×UInt32 E2E header + UInt8 value unchanged
approach:
[Objective]
E2E (End-to-End protection) header round-trip: DUT preserves the AUTOSAR E2E header bytes alongside the payload value.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_e2e_echo_mismatch: echoUINT8E2E response did not match Request
